title: Both Wolf Scrape (gaunt wolf) and Twin Stones (ash wolf) describe the creature as one that 'will let you pass if you let it be,' and Lys says outright 'We can go around' — but the only listed menu action is to attack it; there is no explicit 'leave it be' / 'go around' option, so avoiding the fight requires the player to intuit that quietly walking to another exit (rather than attacking) is the 'go around.' Attacking anyway (required to complete the hunter's own 'Hunter's Sortie' quest) costs Lys regard both times, escalating to 'one more thing and I'm done following you.'
where: Vale of Ash / Wolf Scrape and Twin Stones (attack gaunt wolf / attack ash wolf)
